items.stem: What are the three parts of a good instruction to an AI?
Which part says what job the AI should do?
Which part gives the AI the facts it needs?
Which part describes the shape of the answer you want?
'Summarize this report in three plain sentences.' Which part is 'in three plain sentences'?
Why is 'Tell me about marketing' a weak instruction?

options.C: It gives no task, context, or format

items.stem: A good instruction to an AI is most like:

options.B: A clear brief to a colleague

items.stem: You want a birthday message for Ana who loves gardening, in two short lines. Which part is 'who loves gardening'?

options.C: Task: write a 3-line update. Context: sales rose 10%. Format: plain sentences
